summary: Large golf-club car park backing onto bush; nearest homes about 80 m away.
reasons: Sealed car park with room for vans

best_section.where: Western end of the Minnippi golf club car park, away from the clubhouse

drivers.seclusion: Car park edged by bush on the west and south; the only nearby homes are across a gully to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed access road and many marked bays; the western gravel and asphalt area has plenty of room.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end club access road; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Public club car park; other cars present by day, no vans or tents seen.

flags: Slope about 6% across the pin area, flatter in the car park
Possible gate or after-hours closure not visible from above
sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; bush shades the west edge in the afternoon.
